class shopping and entertainment in Dallas.

Our deluxe facilities and services will make you feel right at home at American RV. In fact, we’re never surprised when a guest wants to extend their stay!

Amenities include: two sparkling clean laundry/rest room facilities, free mail service and a community room for guest functions all managed by our professional on-site staff. And it’s going to get even better in 2021 with the addition of 20 covered sites, a swimming pool and an improved dog park.

At the American RV Park Resort we’ve hosted RV rallies and group events for years. For smaller groups we can accommodate up to 50 guests in the Liberty Hall.

record.description:
The beautiful East Fork Campground & Horse Hotel is a locally owned and operated business located in Durbin, West Virginia. Owners: Jonathan, Angela, Tony and Eileen welcome you to enjoy some breathtaking views and make memories in one of the prettiest campgrounds in our Mountain State. 


Our camping season opens to guests April 1 and runs thru October 31.

Located next to the beautiful Greenbrier river, guests will enjoy clean restrooms, hot showers, municipal water, full-service hook-ups (30 amps), a dump station, horse stalls, a pavilion and playground. 

We welcome campers of all kinds ---Pop-ups, Truck slide-ins, motor homes, travel trailers, horse rigs, and tents.

With the ability to board your horses and stables that offer access to pasture; riding on the West Fork River Trail, Allegheny Trail, High Falls of Cheat, and the Greenbrier River trail has never been easier. 

Forgot an item when packing? Don't worry, our fully stocked camp store will provide the perfect opportunity to snag some East Fork gear or grab that missing essential item!

The East Fork Campground & Horse Hotel provides a space for our guests; both people and horses to connect with nature, relax and unwind while making memories with friends and family, and enjoy all of the amenities from home! 

Looking for an adventure while staying with us?

Pocahontas County is home to unique attractions, like Steam-driven locomotives. Jump aboard the Durbin Rocket and experience the Monongahela National Forest and mountain vistas like never before. Guests can also take a 15-minute drive to the Green Bank Observatory and go behind the scenes of science with a High Tech Tour.

record.description:
Discover the joys of summer at Baylor Beach Park, Water Park & Campground! Family-owned and operated since 1954, our park is located in beautiful Ohio, just minutes from the World's Largest Amish Settlement, and also near Canton's Pro Football Hall of Fame.

Our Senior & Family-Friendly RV Park has hosted generations of families from all over who come to visit us along with the Holmes County Area: Berlin, Kidron, Millersburg, Mt. Hope, Sugarcreek & Walnut Creek. Discover the best of both worlds, as our campground along with the local community offer enjoyment for those who are young, and those who are young at heart! Our friendly, helpful staff and well-maintained park will certainly be a pleasure for your camping trip.

Our campground features easy access for large R.V. units, level sites, chipped & sealed roads, and sites that include 30/50 amps with Water/Electric, or Full-service hook-ups. WiFi is free; Honeywagon Service is available. Campers, along with their pets, can stroll along the peaceful walking path surrounded by lots of green space to take in the solitude of nature. Swimming is included in the summertime, so be sure to take time to cool off on those lazy summer days, you will have a splashing good time enjoying the great outdoors while having "Fun in the Sun!”

Camping is open from May 1 - October 22th weekend. Area Information is available in our office. We hope you stop by to visit; we are certain you will make lots of new memories when staying with us!

record.description:
West Boggs Park, created in 1972, features a 622-acre lake with some of the best fishing around!

Our campground offers 145 campsites that accommodate tents and RVs. We also offer an 18-hole putt putt course, Stolls Lakeview Restaurant, 9 holes of traditional golf, disc golf, kayak rentals, miles of trails, concerts and entertainment, shelter houses, and lots of fun activities and events!

For those seeking a more turnkey camping experience, we offer 2 fully equipped rental cabins and 4 rental mobile homes, perfect for visitors who prefer the comforts of home while still enjoying the great outdoors.

Our campground is divided into distinct areas—each named after native Indiana wildlife—offering a range of landscapes, views, and amenities. From shaded, wooded lots to lakefront sites with stunning views, every area provides a unique camping experience. Amenities throughout the park include bathhouses, laundry facilities, a playground, and access to recreational opportunities across West Boggs Lake.

Campsite maps are available to help you find your perfect spot, and our convenient online reservation system makes it easy to book your stay in just a few clicks. Whether you’re a seasoned RV traveler, a tent camper, or new to outdoor adventures, you’ll find that West Boggs Park has everything you need for a memorable stay.

record.description:
Experience the harmony of nature on our 160 acre campground located in the heart of New Jersey’s Kittatinny Mountains. Easily accessible from all directions in the tri-state area, Harmony Ridge is open year-round for your enjoyment. Come sit a spell and join our family in front of the lounge fireplace and meet new friends to share camping adventures. The friends and memories you make here will last a lifetime.


Ed and Dorin Ann Risdon purchased 160 acres in 1963. Harmony Ridge opened on July 4th 1966 with 10 campsites with the men still working on the bathrooms. Kerosene lanterns were put in the bathrooms and would last until sunup. Campers came and enjoyed swimming, fishing, and hiking. Family and friends all gathered around the campfires for song and story telling. Today we have over 200 sites and many activities to choose from; a large pavilion, playground, shuffleboard, bocci ball, volleyball, horseshoe, swimming pool, basketball court, and paddle boats. Our newest additions are the hockey rink, a baseball field, and a gaga ball court and our brand NEW playground. Some weekends, we host events for the community. Campers are invited to watch baseball games of local teams and our tractor pulls. Brittany and Sue run the office and Edwin Jr. and Trevor manage the grounds and the equipment. In 1992 Ed Jr. married Susan and in 2011 Beth married Frank. Ed Sr. passed away in 2020 and Doris passed in 2022 from Alzheimers. Our newest addition to the family, the 4th generation, is Jayden Risdon who is now 12 years old and new baby sister Raelynn who was born in December 2024. New generations will bring new ideas and new activities to the campground. The towers on the mountain are also owned by the Risdon family. Commercial radios and paging systems mix the modern fast-pace life with the slow, relaxing life of the country living on the campground.

record.description:
Welcome to our peaceful RV park located in High Island, TX on the beautiful Bolivar Peninsula, just 15 minutes east of Crystal Beach. Our park is located about half a mile from High Island Beach, home of the famous cross and excellent seashell, sea glass, and shark tooth hunting! We offer 24 full hookup sites, 6 of which are pull throughs, as well as a tent camping area with electric and water hookups.

We're proud to offer free wifi, free ice, free compressed air, a dog park, a bathroom with a shower, and a coin operated laundry facility. Plus, you'll have great AT&T and Verizon service in the park. Our park is a peaceful escape from the noise - close enough to the beach and action but far enough away to be quiet.

We're located across the street from very famous bird sanctuaries that are hot spots for bird watching and also great for hiking year round. This is the perfect spot for those who want to relax and enjoy nature full of singing birds and a calming fountain. Come stay with us and experience "the oasis of Bolivar Peninsula"!

record.description:
The spirit of the Old West is alive and kickin' at Wagon Master RV Park, where good old fashioned Texas ambiance meets the latest in luxury RV facilities. Alpacas graze, shade trees beckon, and if you listen real hard, you can almost hear the jingle of spurs. Shoot, it wasn't so long ago that outlaws like the notorious Sam Bass ruled these parts, and settlers in covered wagons moseyed down the nearby Chisolm Trail. Well, Bass and his henchmen are long gone, but the covered wagons--RVs to you and me--are rollin' in from far and wide, drawn to Wagon Master's wide open spaces and rich Texas heritage.

Don't Fence Me In.

This being Texas and all, we reckon our guests appreciate a little extra elbow room. So that's how we designed Wagon Master RV Park. Our spacious sites pretty much guarantee that you and your posse won't feel fenced in.

Home on the Range.

With our deluxe facilities and services, you'll feel right at home at Wagon Master. In fact, we reckon you'll want to stay a spell. We have full hook-ups (20, 30 & 50 amp), water and sewer at each of our 102 sites. Amenities include: A state of the art laundry facility, a nice pool, free mail service, a community room for park socials, stock pens for overnight horse guests, dog corrals for off-leash play and on-site owners.

Bring Your Posse.

Whether you're planning a rally for your club or a reunion for your kids, we're pleased to welcome groups of just about any size. Your group will enjoy: Our community room, RV sites near each other, and a free wagon ride through the alpaca fields for a close-up look.

It's All About Location.

Less than a mile west of I-35, Wagon Master's prime location in north Texas means you're just a gallop away from great shopping, recreation and dozens of other family friendly attractions. Here are just a few: Texas Motor Speedway, Lake Ray Roberts, Ft Worth Stockyards, Germanfest in Muenster, The Winstar Casino, & Babe's Chicken Dinner House.
record.events:
Join us for daily alpaca feedings! Get up close and personal with our herd of beautiful alpacas. Learn about their origin, what they eat and the benefits of their all natural, hypoallergenic fiber! See the office for details.

March 31st, 2019 @ 11:00am - Join us for alpaca sheering! Enjoy coffee and doughnuts and an educational experience. The famous Mark Lofhagen will be here again to sheer! Learn the in's and out's of how these amazing animals cool off for the upcoming summer months! Get down and dirty helping or stand from afar and watch the magic happen, it's all up to you. See the office for details!

April 14th, 2019 @ 5:00-7:00pm - Texas Storm Chasers: Spring weather is no the horizon and Texas Storm Chasers will be at the Wander Inn building to present a great workshop about severe weather safety, especially when living in an RV. This date is currently tentative but we will notify everyone once the date has been confirmed. 

October 2019 - Help us welcome our new cria (baby alpacas). They almost always come during a stormy night near Halloween! It's amazing to watch these dainty babies pronk through the fields of Wagon Master. 

November 2019 - Join us in the Wander Inn for our annual Winterizing Seminar. Learn the best methods to keep your rig winterized and free-free during the coldest months of the year. Stay posted for the exact day and time.

record.description:
A dramatic drive down the river valley where Pipestone Creek meets the Wapiti River, lies the hidden valley of Pipestone Creek Campground. Located along the Wapiti River, near one of the richest areas for dinosaur fossils in western Canada, and the largest site in the world for Pachyrhinosaurus fossils.

The park is located just 16 kilometers south of Wembley. Head west on Hwy #43, then south through the Town of Wembley, and follow signs to the park. Thanks to this ultra-rich fossil bone-bed, Wembley is proud to be the home of the Philip J. Currie Dinosaur museum. Our campground is the perfect base for exploring the museum and the other gems in the County of Grande Prairie.

High River's Hidden Jewel!

George Lane Campground is open from May 1st to September 30th.

Set in a secluded area beside the Highwood River, close to unique downtown High River, Alberta, Canada, this campground is 60 km (35 miles) south of Calgary on Highway 2, within easy walking distance of shopping and restaurants.

There is an overnight group site (Site B) that can accommodate tents and RV's.  This area has 15 amp RV power connections, a group fire pit, picnic tables and a kitchen shelter which has electricity, water and a large wood stove.

There are also, 2 day use areas (Sites A & C), each with picnic tables and a large group fire pit.

Centrally located in Alberta, Entwistle RV Campground welcomes you to come aboard and explore the natural beauty of the Pembina River gorge characterized by the deep history of Entwistle and Evansburg. Campground rates include firewood, dump stations, water stations, flush toilets, pit toilets, hiking trails, children's play area, StoryBook trail, horseshoes, and an outdoor recreation area. Nearby you can enjoy river tubing, golf, local farmers markets, or one of the many annual events such as the Entwistle Rodeo. Come stay at this family owned, family run, and family friendly campground.

Whitcomb Creek County Park is a primitive campground nestled in the forest along Green Peter Reservoir. It offers a quiet setting for bird-watching, fishing, hiking, kayaking, and other water activities. The park provides non-hookup campsites and yurts, including a small yurt village with select units featuring decks overlooking the reservoir through the trees. Two nearby boat ramps provide water access, and the park includes restrooms and hand-pump water.


Please note the Green Peter reservoir's water level often drops early in the season resulting in the Whitcomb boat ramp being unusable. In these conditions the Thistle Creek boat ramp can be used to gain access to Green Peter. The Thistle Creek boat ramp is about a 7-minute ride down Quartzville Drive from Whitcomb. This boat ramp often closes around the end of August also due to water levels.

We offer full hook-ups, back-in or pull-thru sites, Wi-Fi, a dump station, covered pavilion for gatherings, a children’s playground and restroom with showers.

Our laundry and community facility offers 8 washers and dryers, a sitting area, pool table, vending machines, fireplace, and TV.

record.events:
Central Oregon has many outdoor adventures to offer it's visitors. Just 7 miles East of our RV Park is Ochoco Reservoir which boasts great fishing and water recreation. 22 miles to the South is Prineville Reservoir State Park offering a large water recreation area. Walton Lake, a great non-motorized lake in the woods for a day of fishing, is located 32 miles to the East. For hikers there is Steins Pillar located 31 miles to the East and Smith Rock State Park, home to impressive rock climbing, is located 20 miles to the West. The Painted Hills Park is 51 miles to the East and the John Day Fossil Beds are 81 miles to the East. Located just across the road from our RV Park is a Youth Angling Pond, Dog Park and the Crooked River which offers great fly fishing fun. There are miles of biking and hiking trails for the outdoor enthusiasts.

Prineville is home of The Round Up each June, the Horse Races in July and the county fair in August.

Paulina Rodeo takes place each Labor Day Weekend.

Check out the Crook County Chamber of Commerce Calendar for upcoming events and activities!

record.description:
Bare Oaks Family Naturist Park is a year-round naturist park near Toronto in Canada where the entire family can experience traditional naturist values in a modern setting. We are nestled among the natural wilderness of the Ontario Greenbelt and Oak Ridges Moraine. Our varied landscape includes open spaces, forests, ponds, streams and a small lake. We also have many recreational facilities. Our clubhouse provides year-round amenities including saunas and a whirlpool. Bare Oaks offers day-use memberships and seasonal campsites but also welcomes visitors and travellers.

Some might use the terms nudist and nudism to describe us and what we do. But we prefer naturist and naturism because our creed is so much more than just taking your clothes off. It is a life philosophy with physical, psychological, environmental, social and moral benefits. We go beyond a mere recreational pursuit and promote ethical naturism. We endeavour to live a naturist life and nudity is key to body acceptance and an integral part of our naturist philosophy. As such, we are not clothing-optional. Clothing is worn only for protection. But we do give new visitors a chance to adjust.

If this is your naturist experience or just your first visit to Bare Oaks, you will find the answers to many your questions here: https://www.BareOaks.ca/first-visit/

Welcome to Fisherman's Cove Campground. Located East of Kincardine on a private spring-fed lake. We offer fully serviced campsites and cabin rentals May through October. 


Camping at Fisherman’s Cove allows your family to enjoy the great outdoors, but recognizes that there are some modern perks which would make your experience better. At Fisherman’s Cove, families receive exclusive access to:

  • 500 fully serviced campsites spread over a 250 acre facility
  • Wifi 
  • 5 playgrounds
  • Off Leash dog park & dog Beach
  • 200 acre spring fed lake
  • 6000 square foot Recreation Centre
  • 9300 square foot Clubhouse
  • 2 indoor pools & whirlpools

  • Pike & bass fishing,
  • Groomed beach area with inflatable water toys

Take a road trip to:

  • The Bruce County Museum in Southhammpton
  • The Kincardine Lighthouse and Museum

record.description:
Welcome to Sauble Beach Resort Camp. We are a well-established and supervised family campground, where we offer 300 available sites for seasonal and overnight camping. We are located just minutes from Sauble Beach, the second-largest freshwater beach in the world, with an 11-kilometer stretch of white sand beach, offering breath-taking sunsets and amazing views of the Lake Huron shoreline! 


Sauble Beach has been voted the #1 beach in Ontario and is a very popular summer family destination! The Sauble area is also a fisherman’s paradise. In the spring, large rainbow trout can be seen vaulting up the Sauble River Falls and in the summer, lake trout, northern pike, perch, small mouth bass, walleye, and whitefish are in abundance.


Our facilities include indoor and outdoor pool, hot tub, childrens playground, volleyball, horseshoes, recreation hall, laundry, propane sales, 21 Rental Trailers, and 100 short-term camping sites, some with water, electricity, and sewer. Enforced quite time from 11:00pm to 7:00am, and an on site recreation director.

Manistee River RV Resort is a family friendly fishing fanatic paradise. The Resort is located on Manistee River right as it dumps into Manistee Lake, with access to Lake Michigan. With 187 sites, 50 Marina slips, 9 Rental Units and a large campstore, the Resort can meet all of your camping and fishing needs. The Campstore has fishing tackle for aisles and aisles; refreshments, snacks, camping equipment, toys and most importantly, ICE CREAM.

For the anglers, we have a Boat Ramp, Marina slips for rent, Fish Cleaning Station, Freezers to store your catch and every fishing tackle and bait that you would ever need.

Manistee is a hot bed of activity during the summer and early fall. Come for the fishing, stay for the fun and great shopping in downtown Manistee.
